reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a step-by-step educational demonstration of creating a Binance account, funding it, and using the BNB spot-trading interface. The referral code and benefit claims are disclosed as an affiliate promotion, while the cryptocurrency risk warning and statement that it is not investment advice make the apparent promotional cues insufficient to establish deception.

citations.quote: Today I will demonstrate how to trade the official token of Binance Global, the BNB Token, a.k.a BNB Coin, and my referral code
Firstly, we need to create an account on Binance Global with referral code for commission discount commission kickback.
with this code up to 20% trade rebates Commission discount or Commission kickback and up to 600 USA dollar new user bonus
Using a referral code may provide trading fee discounts and promotional bonuses depending on current Binance campaigns.
Go to Binance registration page Enter your email or phone number Create a secure password Enter the referral code JL3MPH7U

opening.argument: The presentation links a concrete financial incentive to a specific signup action, making this more than neutral trading education. Viewers are told to create a Binance account using the referral code, while the same pitch promises “up to 20%” rebates and “up to 600” dollars in bonus value. The signup screen visibly pairs “Unlock Exclusive Rewards” with the referral code, an email or phone field, and account creation. That is a direct promise-action funnel: provide personal information, register through the supplied code, and potentially deposit or trade in pursuit of the advertised benefit. Calling the process a tutorial does not change that the central call to action is account acquisition through the promoter’s referral pathway.

citations.quote: Firstly, we need to create an account on Binance Global with referral code for commission discount commission kickback.
with this code up to 20% trade rebates Commission discount or Commission kickback and up to 600 USA dollar new user bonus

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account treats disclosure as if it eliminates the solicitation. It does not: the affiliate disclosure confirms that the promoter benefits from viewers using the code, while the video still directs viewers to a particular registration route and associates it with rewards. A risk disclaimer likewise does not resolve whether the advertised signup benefit is presented in a misleadingly attractive way. The operational steps are the mechanism for converting viewers into referred users, not evidence that the promotion is merely descriptive.

citations.quote: Links on this site may be affiliate links, such as our Binance partner code (JL3MPH7U).
you should click this banner or in this video info section referral url

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted material establishes a disclosed referral incentive, not a false or guaranteed cash payout. The description expressly qualifies that referral benefits depend on current campaigns, and the video presents the rebate and bonus as platform promotions rather than an invented investment return. The signup and trading steps show ordinary account use; they do not show that users lose funds or that the stated benefits are unavailable.

citations.quote: Using a referral code may provide trading fee discounts and promotional bonuses depending on current Binance campaigns.
with this code up to 20% trade rebates Commission discount or Commission kickback and up to 600 USA dollar new user bonus

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together in one acquisition flow: a referral URL, a prominently advertised rebate and bonus, identity verification, first deposit, and requests for contact information. The thumbnail itself presents “KYC” and “FIRST DEPOSIT” beside “MY REFERRAL CODE,” while the signup panel promises “Unlock Exclusive Rewards.” The spoken instructions then direct viewers to click the referral banner, complete verification, and deposit or buy crypto. Even if each step can occur on a legitimate exchange, combining an easy-sounding reward with personal-data collection and a funding step creates a persuasive funnel whose attractive headline can overshadow the material conditions and risks.

citations.quote: With your phone, thirty seconds or one minute in, you complete with you. Should use your passport or national ID or a residence permit. or driver license.
Click deposit. Select your currency.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense emphasizes that the video shows real interface operations, but an authentic-looking interface does not validate every promotional claim surrounding it. Nor does saying the code “may” provide benefits explain the unusually prominent reward framing, the external referral destination, or why viewers must proceed through verification and funding steps. The issue is the cumulative solicitation: the tutorial’s practical detail makes the promotional pathway easier to follow and therefore more consequential.

citations.quote: Create an account: https://accounts.binance.com/register?ref=JL3MPH7U

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The visuals and instructions show standard exchange onboarding and trading, including KYC and a deposit choice; they do not establish that these are deceptive requirements. The material also warns that crypto trading involves significant risk and is not investment advice. The reward language is qualified as campaign-dependent, so the evidence supports a disclosed promotion with conditions, not a fraudulent low-barrier payout.

citations.quote: Risk Warning: Crypto trading involves significant risk. This is not investment advice.
Using a referral code may provide trading fee discounts and promotional bonuses depending on current Binance campaigns.

opening.argument: Although packaged as beginner education, the content functions as a referral advertisement. The title centers on buying and selling BNB, but the spoken introduction immediately foregrounds the presenter’s referral code, directs viewers to his website, and claims substantial signup-related benefits. The supplied description also labels the presenter an official affiliate and repeatedly provides the registration link and code. The trading demonstration gives the promotion credibility and a practical path to act on it: create an account, complete KYC, deposit money, and buy BNB. The instructional wrapper therefore steers participation toward the promoter’s monetized referral channel rather than neutrally teaching exchange mechanics.

citations.quote: Today I will demonstrate how to trade the official token of Binance Global, the BNB Token, a.k.a BNB Coin, and my referral code
if you need more information you should visit my website exchange referral codes dot com
Verified by: Official Binance Affiliate Emre Ata
Create an account: https://accounts.binance.com/register?ref=JL3MPH7U

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls the material an operational walkthrough, but that is precisely what makes the promotional role effective: viewers receive actionable instructions ending in a referred account and funded trading activity. The affiliate status and disclosure identify a commercial relationship; they do not make the presentation neutral. Repeating the referral route, code, and benefit claims alongside the tutorial indicates that education is being used to drive participation.

citations.quote: Links on this site may be affiliate links, such as our Binance partner code (JL3MPH7U).
For selling click sell and sell your BNB.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclosed affiliate relationship can coexist with genuine education. The material gives concrete navigation and trading instructions, expressly says the content is not financial advice, and cautions viewers about volatility and social-media misinformation. Those statements undermine the claim that the instructional framing merely disguises a scam; the cited promotion is transparent and tied to ordinary exchange use.
